target.title: fix(ui): make session history accessible in picker and sidebar
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #95601 for the current Control UI session-history surface.

Unlabeled chat sessions can otherwise appear as raw scoped session keys, and sidebar recent sessions did not expose enough list semantics / active-state context for assistive technologies. The current branch narrows the PR back to the live 9-file scope after rebasing on the latest `main`: readable derived session titles, sidebar list semantics, and proof that readable titles survive normal session patch refreshes.

## Summary

- Adds optional `derivedTitle` typing/display support for Control UI session rows.
- For chat session history loads, forwards `includeDerivedTitles` through the sessions capability and requests it from the chat session list.
- Uses `derivedTitle` as the readable fallback before raw session keys in session display helpers.
- Gives sidebar recent sessions list/listitem semantics and richer accessible names that include readable title, timestamp metadata, active-state text, active-run state, and unread state.
- Marks the active sidebar session link with `aria-current="page"`.
- Preserves the most recent `sessions.list` options when refreshing after `sessions.patch`, so `includeDerivedTitles` is not dropped by ordinary patch paths such as model/pin/unread changes.
- Adds unit/jsdom/browser coverage for derived-title display and patch-refresh preservation.

## Scope / Overlap Note

This PR is now the narrower derived-title + sidebar-accessibility slice. It no longer claims to add or prove picker/sidebar rename controls from earlier branch iterations. Historical proof for older rename-control heads has been removed from this body to keep the review evidence aligned with the current patch.

## Compatibility / Migration

No migration is required.

- `derivedTitle` is optional on `GatewaySessionRow` and optional in the local session-display row shape.
- Existing serialized/cached rows without `derivedTitle` continue to fall back through the existing display order.
- The patch-refresh change only reuses the last successful list options; it does not alter persisted session data or the `sessions.patch` RPC payload.

## Evidence

Current head: `1c622966712ebae1c3e841ca5ddfed3d7d2f0282`  
Base checked against latest `main`: `7c0a7c8be210c7d95b0b4e6b4cf0126e5c2e7e44`

Patch-quality evidence added in this head:

- `ui/src/lib/sessions/index.test.ts`
  - verifies `sessions.patch` refreshes reuse the prior list options
  - specifically asserts `includeDerivedTitles: true` survives the post-patch `sessions.list`
  - confirms the patch RPC payload stays unchanged (`key`, `agentId`, patch fields only)
- `ui/src/e2e/chat-flow.e2e.test.ts`
  - browser/DOM test sets up two `sessions.list` responses: one with `derivedTitle` only when `includeDerivedTitles` is requested, and one without it
  - opens the Control UI chat page
  - verifies the sidebar displays the readable derived title instead of the raw session key
  - verifies the active sidebar link exposes `aria-current="page"`
  - performs a real UI model-change action that sends `sessions.patch`
  - verifies the following refresh requests `includeDerivedTitles: true`
  - verifies the sidebar still displays the readable title and keeps active accessible state after the patch refresh
- `ui/src/pages/overview/view.render.test.ts`
  - verifies overview recent-session rendering uses derived titles for unlabeled rows
- `ui/src/pages/chat/chat-send.test.ts`
  - verifies chat session list requests include derived titles
- `git diff --check`: passed locally before push
- Conflict scan: no unmerged files and no conflict markers before push

## Current-Head GitHub Actions Evidence

Exact-head checks were triggered after pushing `1c622966712ebae1c3e841ca5ddfed3d7d2f0282`.

- CI run: <https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28865767397>
- Real behavior proof check: <https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28865765327>

The CI run is expected to exercise the newly added browser/DOM E2E coverage for the patch-refresh derived-title path. Once the run completes, the check output for the changed UI targets is the current-head proof that normal UI patch actions do not drop readable session titles.

## Not Tested

- Live macOS VoiceOver speech transcript was not re-captured for this narrower current-head patch. The browser/DOM coverage verifies the accessible names and active state that screen readers consume.

target.title: fix(status): keep issue message truncation UTF-16 safe
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where `openclaw status --all` would render broken U+FFFD replacement characters (`�`) in the Channels table Detail column when a gateway issue message contained an emoji or CJK supplementary character at the 90-character truncation boundary.

`String.prototype.slice(0, 90)` cuts at UTF-16 code unit boundaries. Emoji like 🚀 are surrogate pairs (2 code units). When a pair straddles position 90, the lone high surrogate renders as `�` in the terminal.

Channel issues originate from gateway health checks — provider-level warnings/errors reported via gateway probe. They render through the Detail column of the Channels table under `gateway: <issue message>`.

## Why This Change Was Made

Replace `message.slice(0, 90)` in `formatIssueMessage` with `truncateUtf16Safe(message, 90)` — the standard UTF-16-safe truncation helper already used across the codebase.

## User Impact

`openclaw status --all` channel issue messages containing emoji or CJK now display cleanly truncated text in the Detail column, without broken replacement characters.

## Evidence

### Production-path rendering proof (commit 8b1fbe0d)

Calls the exact chain: `buildStatusChannelsSection → buildStatusChannelsTableRows → formatIssueMessage(issue.message)` at `channels-table.ts:44`. Issue title = 89 `x`'s + 🚀, straddling the 90-char boundary.

```
=== BEFORE fix: formatIssueMessage = message.slice(0, 90) ===
  Contains lone high surrogate: true  <- broken U+FFFD in Detail column

=== AFTER fix: formatIssueMessage = truncateUtf16Safe(message, 90) ===
  Contains lone high surrogate: false <- clean truncation
```

### Real `openclaw status --all` on this branch

```
$ node openclaw.mjs status --all
Git   fix/status-report-utf16-safe-truncation @ 8b1fbe0d

Channels
+---------+---------+-------+--------------------------------------------+
| Channel | Enabled | State | Detail                                     |
+---------+---------+-------+--------------------------------------------+
| Matrix  | ON      | OK    | configured                                 |
+---------+---------+-------+--------------------------------------------+

! Channel issues skipped (gateway unreachable)
```

The `formatIssueMessage` callback at `report-lines.ts:92` is exercised by the production-path rendering proof above. Channel issues require a live gateway to populate; the rendering chain proof covers the boundary behavior directly.

### Tests

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/commands/status-all/report-lines.test.ts

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  3 passed (3)
```

### Files Changed (2 files, +21/-1)

```
 src/commands/status-all/report-lines.test.ts | 19 +++++++++++++++++++
 src/commands/status-all/report-lines.ts      |  3 ++-
```
